mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id, m.nickname, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.profile, ''), '/images/common_member.png') AS profile, DATE_FORMAT(f.follow_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS follow_at_str FROM follow f JOIN member m ON m.member_id = f.follower_id WHERE f.followee_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY f.follow_at DESC, m.nickname ASC
